You can deploy a fully operational online store with automatic crypto payment processing in one afternoon, using the Sovereign [[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-how-start-[[LINK:https://coremerch.github.io/store/blog/how-selling-digital-products-without-stripe-works-how-3|COREMERCH guide to selling]]-digital-products-crypto-works-6|How How]]er Stack ($97), which includes GitHub Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This is the base-layer infrastructure you need to sell your music online and accept Bitcoin, and it can be deployed in just 48 hours.
The Minimum Viable Stack That Works

The Edge Commerce Stack ($197) includes Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers for backend logic, Supabase for order storage, and NOWPayments for automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This stack is ideal for artists who want to sell music online and accept Bitcoin, as it provides end-to-end testing, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration, and automatic delivery of products via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. You can deploy the Edge Commerce Stack in just 48 hours and start selling your music online and accepting Bitcoin.
Skipping the Steps That Do Not Matter Yet

You don't need to worry about setting up a buyer account or dealing with KYC requirements when using NOWPayments. You can focus on deploying your sovereign digital commerce stack, and NOWPayments will take care of the automatic on-chain crypto payment verification. This means you can skip the steps that do not matter yet and get your first transaction live in no time.
You can deploy a sovereign digital commerce stack in one afternoon and start selling your music online and accepting Bitcoin in no time.
Getting Your First Transaction Live

The order management layer gives you complete visibility into every transaction your store processes. In Stack 01, every order is logged to a Google Sheet with the buyer's email, product purchased, payment amount in crypto and USD equivalent, transaction hash for on-chain verification, and delivery status. In Stack 02, orders are stored in a Supabase PostgreSQL database with the same fields plus additional metadata. Both can be exported as CSV at any time. The transaction hash provides cryptographic proof of every payment that does not depend on any platform's records — you can verify any transaction independently on a public blockchain explorer.
What to Do in the Next 24 Hours

Scaling a sovereign digital store requires no infrastructure changes at any realistic volume level for most individual creators. Cloudflare Workers processes each webhook event independently — ten simultaneous orders are handled as ten separate processes with no queue congestion. Supabase handles hundreds of concurrent database operations on the free tier. Resend delivers 3,000 emails per month on the free tier — enough for significant daily sales volume. Cloudflare Pages serves the storefront to any number of concurrent visitors without capacity constraints. NOWPayments processes payment volume without per-transaction approval delays.
